items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: I heard of him, but I don't know. He's a drum player. Where did Marlis S. get to play?

ctx.x: I never did catch a band. I keep going back and there's never any band. I'll be doing it. And with George Wagner.
I guess you heard of George Wagner. I heard of him, but I don't know. He's a drum player. Where did Marlis S. get to play?
